name: XHTheme AI Toolbox
author: xhtheme

sections.description:
XHTheme AI Toolbox is a professional WordPress AI plugin built by the XHTheme team. It brings AI writing, AI translation, AI summary, AI tagging, AI categorization, AI text-to-image, AI smart comments, automated content workflows and an automation task queue into a single plugin, natively integrated with the Gutenberg block editor and the WordPress admin — so you no longer need to copy and paste between multiple AI platforms.

Product highlights:

  • Gutenberg AI Workbench — Call AI directly from the block editor sidebar for writing, rewriting, expanding, polishing and full-post translation.
  • Content Workflow — Analyze your site, plan category strategies, maintain title queues, and automatically generate and schedule new articles for each enabled category.
  • Unified Admin Dashboard — Model status, quota balance, automation switches, task queue, runtime notifications and support tickets are all gathered on a single page.
  • Cloud Model Routing + Advanced Models — In automatic mode the cloud picks the most suitable model for each task; when you need more power you can switch to an advanced model (including reasoning models) for long-form writing, high-quality translation, complex rewriting and deep topic expansion.
  • Complete Comment Operation Suite — Auto comment generation, AI comment personas, random comments, auto moderation and AI-powered author replies — a full solution for comment-section operations.
  • Rule-based Automation — When you publish a post, AI tasks are automatically queued and executed in the background, with queue management, retry and timeout handling.

Suitable for personal blogs, content sites, news sites, vertical industry sites, creator sites, WooCommerce stores and any WordPress site that wants to boost content production with AI.

Official Overview

Key Features

Gutenberg AI Workbench — Your AI Assistant Inside the WordPress Editor

Use AI directly from the block editor sidebar: AI writing, paragraph rewriting, content polishing, content expansion, full-post translation and editing assistance. Writing, editing and translating all happen inside Gutenberg — no need to switch to external tools.

Content Workflow — Plan, Generate and Schedule Site Content

Content Workflow turns an ongoing content strategy into an automated publishing process. It analyzes your existing site and categories, helps plan category coverage, maintains a title queue for each enabled category, and generates complete articles according to the configured topic scope and writing style.

Each category can have its own publishing frequency, author, content limit, web-search option and image strategy. The first article is distributed within an initial two-hour window, while later articles follow the configured schedule. Workflows and individual categories can be paused, resumed and reviewed from the WordPress admin.

AI Summary Generation — One-click article summary and reading hook

Automatically generate AI summaries from article content, choose between traditional summary style or a guided reading hook, use multiple preset styles out of the box, or let AI generate custom styles for you. Summaries can also be synced to the default WordPress excerpt field to improve your SEO description quality.

AI Tag Extraction — Auto-extract tags and complete SEO metadata

AI analyzes the full article, extracts the most relevant tags, and automatically fills in SEO title, English slug, tag description and other metadata for new tags. Existing tags are recognized to avoid duplicates.

AI Auto Categorization and English Slug Generation

AI automatically selects the most appropriate category from your existing categories. It also generates an SEO-friendly English URL slug based on the article content, deeply matching the article keywords.

AI Text-to-Image — Multi-platform image generation

Generate illustrations and cover images based on the article topic, with multi-platform support (Alibaba Cloud Bailian Tongyi Wanxiang, Zhipu, official channel, etc.). You can set aspect ratio, automatically apply images as the post cover, insert them into the article body, and configure custom Model IDs for third-party platforms.

AI Smart Comment Assistant — Auto-moderation + Auto-reply + Engagement

A complete AI comment operations suite:

  • AI Auto Comment Generation: Automatically generates comments when a post is published, or batch-generates comments from the admin.
  • AI Comment Personas: Readers can @-mention an AI persona inside a comment to trigger an interactive reply.
  • AI Random Comments: Auto-posts comments with configurable frequency and daily limits.
  • AI Comment Moderation: Automatically moderates real user comments, with delayed moderation and spam filtering.
  • AI Author Reply: Automatically generates author replies for both real and AI-generated comments.
  • Smart Interaction Mode: Simulates natural conversations between AI personas and real users to boost engagement.

AI Topic Expansion — Content matrix generator

AI analyzes the current article to generate extended reading directions and topic tags, displayed below the post content to help you build a content matrix.

Automation Task Queue — Triggered on publish, executed silently in the background

Rule-based automation: when a post is published, AI tasks are automatically queued according to your rules. Supports task rules, feature switches, per-category exclusions, queue status, task retry, batch delete, timeout handling, and PostMeta-based triggering (works with importer / publishing tools).

Unified Admin Dashboard

The dashboard surfaces model status, quota balance, feature entry points, automation switches, queue task count, runtime notifications and support ticket submission in one place — making configuration, monitoring and troubleshooting much easier.

Cloud Model Routing and Advanced Models

  • Automatic model mode: The cloud routes each request to the most suitable model based on task type — zero configuration, works out of the box.
  • One-click advanced model switching: Inside the AI panel or workbench you can manually switch to an advanced model (including reasoning models) — ideal for long-form writing, high-quality translation, deep topic expansion and complex rewriting tasks that need stronger understanding and generation.
  • Pay as you need, cost under control: Advanced models consume quota at a multiplier rate, and only when you explicitly choose them. Regular tasks keep running on automatic mode with no extra cost.

Support Tickets and Diagnostics

Submit a support ticket from the admin in one click, with the issue description, environment diagnostics and screenshots automatically attached — shortening support response time.

Image Recognition for Content Supplementation

When the article body is too short or only contains images, AI automatically supplements the content via image recognition for higher-quality generation.

WooCommerce Product Support

Compatible with WooCommerce products — apply AI categorization, tag extraction and comment generation to your products.

Usage and Pricing

All users get a daily free quota, which is suitable for light use of core features such as AI writing, summary, tags and categories. The quota resets automatically every day. For heavier usage, you can upgrade to a paid tier or buy resource packs to extend usage. Advanced models consume quota at a multiplier only when you manually switch to them. Text-to-image is billed separately by the third-party platform you configure in the admin.

How to Use?

1. Trigger AI capabilities via the AI panel

  • Choose which AI capability and custom model to use
  • Works inside the block editor (Gutenberg)
  • You can modify the result before applying it

2. Use AI capabilities via the automation queue

  • When publishing a post you can decide whether to enqueue it; default rules can be configured in the admin
  • Once queued, tasks run silently in the background — no manual work needed
  • Supports all AI capabilities, in both the classic editor and Gutenberg

3. Apply AI capabilities via post-list shortcut buttons

  • The admin post list embeds AI status indicators and one-click action buttons
  • Quickly apply a single AI capability to one post
  • Works in both the classic editor and Gutenberg

4. Apply AI capabilities via PostMeta parameters

  • Designed for importer programs and scheduled-publishing programs
  • When publishing a post, include PostMeta queue parameters and it will be automatically queued

View Documentation

External Services

This plugin connects to the XHTheme AI API (https://www.xhtheme.com) and third-party text-to-image platforms to complete AI generation and processing.

Privacy Policy: https://www.xhtheme.com/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the xhtheme-ai-toolbox folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or search for XHTheme AI Toolbox in the WordPress admin to install it.
  2. Activate XHTheme AI Toolbox from the Plugins page.
  3. Go to “XHTheme AI Assistant → Basic Settings” and follow the wizard to enter your APPID. New sites automatically launch the setup wizard.
  4. Open “XHTheme AI Assistant → Automation” and pick which AI capabilities to run automatically.
  5. When editing a post you will see the Gutenberg AI Workbench in the sidebar.
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

Yes. The plugin relies on cloud AI models, so you need to apply for an APPID at the XHTheme official site.

Does it support multiple languages?

Yes. Recognition for Chinese and English works well, and a per-article language option is available to prevent misdetection. WPML configuration is included so it works well on multilingual sites.

Does it support the classic editor?

Yes. The AI panel, automation queue and post-list shortcut buttons work in both the classic editor and Gutenberg. The Gutenberg AI Workbench is a dedicated sidebar built specifically for the block editor.

Is it compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes. Product pages can use AI categorization, tag extraction and comment generation.

Will my article content be stored on the server?

No. The XHTheme AI platform only performs request routing and authentication, and does not store user-generated content. In special cases, runtime logs may be kept for no more than 30 days for troubleshooting.
